button-padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding of a default Button.

$extensions.amezquita.reason: x matches Prominent but y doesn't (12px, not 16px) — genuine outlier, deliberately left, see decisions/0004.

button-padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of a default Button.

$extensions.amezquita.reason: x matches Prominent but y doesn't (12px, not 16px) — genuine outlier, deliberately left, see decisions/0004.

button-outline-border-width.$description: Border width of the Button variants that draw a border.

button-secondary-background.$description: Fill of the secondary Button at rest: none.

button-secondary-foreground.$description: Text colour of the secondary Button.

button-secondary-border.$description: Border colour of the secondary Button.

button-secondary-background-hover.$description: Fill of the secondary Button on hover.

button-ghost-background.$description: Fill of the ghost Button at rest: none.

button-ghost-border.$description: Border colour of the ghost Button: transparent.

button-spinner-duration.$description: One turn of the spinner in a loading Button.

button-wipe-duration-enter.$description: Expressive motion only: how long the hover wipe takes to fill the Button.

button-wipe-duration-curve.$description: Expressive motion only: each half of the wipe edge's bulge and settle as it fills the Button.

button-wipe-duration-exit.$description: Expressive motion only: how long the wipe takes to clear when the pointer leaves.

button-wipe-duration-curve-out.$description: Expressive motion only: each half of the wipe edge's bulge and settle as it clears.

button-arrow-nudge.$description: How far a Button's trailing arrow moves on hover.

button-glow-size.$description: Expressive motion only: diameter of the highlight on the wipe's crest.

button-glow-color.$description: Highlight riding the crest of the expressive hover wipe. Translucent white rather than a semantic reference: it reads as a light source over whichever fill the wipe paints, not as one of the brand's surface colours. See decisions/0016.
